categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Yuxin Pingrui Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the general gasoline engine and terminal product electronic control components sector. Its main product categories include general gasoline engine power products (igniters, flywheels, charging coils), generator power system accessories (inverters, regulators, permanent magnet motor stators and rotors), and new energy products (drive motors and controllers, range extenders, battery management systems). The company also develops small agricultural machinery such as mini harvesters and rotary tillers, and is expanding into electric drive systems for non-road new energy power equipment including outdoor power tools, garden machinery, engineering machinery, and agricultural machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in ignition systems, inverter control, and permanent magnet motors, breaking foreign monopolies in core components. It employs automated and semi-automated production lines with strict quality control from design to shipment. R&D focuses on digital ignition, high-power digital inverters, permanent magnet brushless DC motors, and intelligent control systems. The company also integrates SMT-DIP manufacturing processes and pursues lean management and smart factory initiatives to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international manufacturers of general gasoline engines and related terminal products such as generators, garden machinery, and agricultural equipment. The company serves leading OEMs in China and abroad, particularly in developed markets like Europe, North America, Oceania, and Japan. It also targets emerging markets in developing countries with growing demand for garden and agricultural machinery. The new energy segment targets customers in non-road electric vehicles, industrial vehicles like forklifts, and unmanned aerial vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and main production facilities in Chongqing. It has established overseas production bases in Vietnam and is constructing a facility in Thailand. Its products are sold domestically and exported internationally, with significant export markets in Europe, North America, Oceania, Japan, and Asia. Export sales have grown substantially, accounting for over 24% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chongqing Yuxin Pingrui Electronic Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core electronic control components for general gasoline engines and new energy power systems. It supplies these components to downstream OEMs who assemble the final machinery and equipment. The company manages procurement of raw materials and some outsourced processing but retains control over key production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology and innovation as core growth drivers, investing heavily in R&D with 8.39% of revenue spent in 2024. Strategic R&D directions include high-efficiency digital ignition systems, high-power digital inverters, permanent magnet brushless DC motors, intelligent motor controllers, and new energy solutions such as lithium battery management, hybrid power systems, and hydrogen fuel engines. It also focuses on smart manufacturing, digitalization, and expanding new energy product lines for non-road vehicles and agricultural machinery.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic control components and finished machinery. The company sells directly to OEM customers and distributors, with export sales conducted mainly on FOB terms. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. The business model is order-driven with a mix of direct sales and distribution channels, emphasizing one-stop procurement services for customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a national high-tech leader and a 'specialized and innovative' 'little giant' enterprise in the core electronic components segment for general gasoline engines. It has broken foreign monopolies in ignition and inverter technologies and maintains a leading quality and scale advantage domestically. Competitors include other domestic and international suppliers of engine electronic components and new energy drive systems, with increasing competition from Southeast Asian and South American low-cost producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 549 million, a 7.85% increase over 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 52.9 million, down 15.47%. Total assets reached RMB 1.22 billion, growing 2.25% year-over-year. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by industry recovery and new customer acquisition, despite short-term profit pressure from increased R&D and new business investments. It maintains a solid asset base and continues to invest in capacity expansion and overseas production.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through strong proprietary technology, stable and high-quality products, and comprehensive product lines covering ignition systems, inverters, permanent magnet motors, and new energy solutions. It offers customers one-stop procurement with a wide range of over 5,000 product models and emphasizes innovation in energy efficiency, digital control, and environmental compliance. Its scale production capabilities and smart manufacturing provide cost advantages and reliable delivery, while its certifications and quality control meet stringent international standards, supporting its competitive positioning in both domestic and export markets.
